_meta.description: VERIFIED market prices: the exact model, seen at a named Polish source on a given date. Only entries here may be shown to a customer as a market price. Anything not listed falls back to app/data/prices/reference_pln.json, which is an ESTIMATE and is labelled as such.
_meta.how_to_add: Run: python -m scripts.set_market_price <component-id> <price> --source "x-kom" --url "https://..." ; or edit by hand with the same fields.

fields.price: number, PLN, incl. VAT, as displayed at the source
fields.source: store name, e.g. x-kom, Morele, Media Expert, Komputronik, Allegro, manufacturer
fields.url: the product page you read the price from
